extension.description: Unofficial: run Cursor agents in VS Code with your Cursor plan and API key. Not affiliated with Anysphere.
command.createPullRequest: Cursor: Create Branch and Pull Request
command.revertLastSession: Cursor: Revert Last AI Change Session
command.scanSupervisorDiagnostics: Cursor: Scan Diagnostics for AI Tasks
command.scanSupervisorGitHub: Cursor: Scan GitHub CI and PR Feedback
command.executeLastPlan: Cursor: Execute Last Plan with Checkpoints
config.enableAiNativeFeatures.descriptio: Master switch for the additional AI-native editor features. Core chat remains available when disabled.
config.maxParallelChatAgents.description: Maximum normal chat agents that may run at once across separate conversations. Concurrent calls can consume plan quota simultaneously, and agents editing the same files may conflict.
config.bestOfNCount.description: How many parallel conversations /compare (best-of-N) should start. Limited by available parallel slots.
config.offerPullRequestAfterVerify.descr: After automatic verification succeeds, offer to create a branch and pull request with the GitHub CLI (gh).
config.defaultBaseBranch.description: Base branch used when creating pull requests with gh.
config.preEditCommands.description: Shell commands to run before an AI change session starts editing. Failures abort the run.
config.postEditCommands.description: Shell commands to run after an AI run finishes with file edits.
config.supervisorAutoApplyGlobs.descript: Glob patterns that may be auto-applied by AI Supervisor when auto-apply is enabled.
config.supervisorTodoTrigger.description: When enabled, saving a file that contains TODO(ai): comments creates AI Supervisor tasks.
config.supervisorTestFailureTrigger.desc: When enabled, failed test-like VS Code tasks create AI Supervisor tasks.
config.supervisorReviewGate.description: After a Supervisor run, ask a second AI pass to approve or reject the change set before review or auto-apply.
config.supervisorMaxParallelTasks.descri: Maximum AI Supervisor tasks that may run concurrently in separate isolated worktrees. File ownership and dependency checks prevent unsafe overlap.
config.supervisorGitHubTrigger.descripti: Poll the current GitHub pull request with gh and create Supervisor tasks for failed CI checks, requested-change reviews, inline review comments, and PR comments marked /cursor, [cursor], or TODO(ai).
config.pipelineAutoKeep.description: Task Pipeline keeps AI edits without the Keep/Restore modal and can create a PR automatically after verification.
config.dailyTokenBudget.description: Soft daily token budget across chat and Supervisor. 0 disables the budget. Warns near 80% and confirms before new runs at 100%.
config.monthlyTokenBudget.description: Soft monthly token budget across chat and Supervisor. 0 disables it. Warns near 80% and confirms before new runs at 100%.
config.monthlyCostLimitUsd.description: Soft monthly estimated cost limit in USD. Requires an estimated cost per million tokens; 0 disables it.
User-supplied blended USD cost per million tokens used only for the estimated monthly cost guardrail. 0 disables cost estimation.
config.changeSessionReviewPolicy.descrip: Default bulk decision for Autopilot change-session review. Automatic keep-all is restricted to trusted workspaces.
config.changeSessionReviewPolicy.prompt: Prompt for Keep or Restore per file.
config.changeSessionReviewPolicy.keepAll: Keep every pending edit automatically in trusted workspaces.
config.changeSessionReviewPolicy.restore: Restore every safely restorable pending edit automatically.
config.enableAiSupervisor.description: Enable the AI Supervisor inbox, local problem detection, and isolated task execution.
config.supervisorMode.description: Controls whether AI Supervisor is off, observes problems only, or runs queued tasks autonomously.
config.supervisorMode.off: Disable problem detection and automatic execution.
config.supervisorMode.observe: Detect problems and add tasks to the inbox without automatically spending AI quota.
config.supervisorMode.autonomous: Automatically execute queued tasks with an independent agent in isolated Git worktrees. Chat remains available, but concurrent runs may consume plan quota at the same time.
config.supervisorDebounceSeconds.descrip: Seconds to wait before starting the next autonomous Supervisor task.
config.supervisorMaxFiles.description: Maximum files an AI Supervisor task may change before approval is safety-blocked.
config.supervisorMaxChangedLines.descrip: Maximum added plus deleted lines before approval is safety-blocked.
config.supervisorMaxAiRunsPerHour.descri: Maximum automatically started AI Supervisor runs per hour. Manual runs are still allowed.
config.supervisorMaxRunMinutes.descripti: Maximum execution time for one AI Supervisor run before it is cancelled.
config.supervisorExcludedGlobs.descripti: Paths AI Supervisor should not modify. Matching changes require an explicit override.
config.supervisorAutoApplySafeChanges.de: Automatically apply verified documentation and test-only changes. Disabled by default.
config.enableAutopilot.description: Enable autonomous outcome-based change sessions through the Autopilot command.
config.enableChangeSessions.description: Track AI edits, show the AI Change Session view, and enable checkpoint-based review and revert.
config.previewGeneratedCode.description: Show a diff and require Apply or Discard before applying Generate Code results.
config.enableDiagnosticQuickFixes.descri: Add Cursor AI Quick Fix actions to diagnostics in the editor.
config.enableAiReview.description: Enable AI review commands and line-level findings in the Problems panel.
config.enableVerification.description: Enable manual and automatic compile, lint, test, or custom verification commands.
config.enableDebugContext.description: Enable AI analysis of the active debug session, diagnostics, and breakpoints.
config.enableProjectMemory.description: Enable project-memory guidance and the project-memory refresh command.
config.notifyOnComplete.description: Show a notification when an agent run finishes. Skipped while the chat view is visible and VS Code is focused.
config.playSoundWhileRunning.description: Play a calm chime periodically while the agent is running.
config.playSoundOnComplete.description: Play a distinct chime when the agent finishes successfully.
config.playSoundOnError.description: Play a distinct alert when the agent stops because of an error.
config.autoVerify.description: Run detected or configured verification commands after an AI agent edits files.
config.autoRepair.description: Ask the agent to repair failed verification automatically. This can use additional plan quota.
config.maxAutoRepairAttempts.description: Maximum automatic repair attempts for one user request.
config.verificationCommands.description: Commands to run after AI edits. Leave empty to detect validate, compile, lint, or test npm scripts.
config.enableInlineCompletions.descripti: Enable production-ready AI inline completions with debounce, LRU caching, request deduplication, budget guards, and acceptance metrics. Disabled by default because requests use Cursor plan quota.
config.inlineCompletionDebounceMs.descri: Delay before an automatic inline-completion request. Explicit invocations bypass the delay.
config.inlineCompletionMinPrefixCharacte: Minimum non-whitespace characters on the current line before requesting a completion.
config.inlineCompletionMaxCharacters.des: Maximum characters returned by one inline completion.
config.inlineCompletionMaxLines.descript: Maximum lines returned by one inline completion.
config.inlineCompletionPauseDuringAgentR: Pause inline-completion requests while chat agents are running to reduce quota contention.
config.inlineCompletionIncludeProjectRul: Load project Cursor rules for inline-completion requests.
config.maxBackgroundJobs.description: Maximum detached background agents that may run at once.
config.backgroundMaxRunMinutes.descripti: Maximum runtime for a detached background agent. The worker continues if VS Code closes and its result is restored on restart.
config.auditSharedLogEnabled.description: Append audit events to a workspace JSONL file that can be shared with the team.
config.auditSharedLogPath.description: Workspace-relative path for the shared JSONL audit log.
config.includeProjectMemory.description: Tell agents to read .cursor/rules.md and .cursor/project-memory.md when present.
